description:
Turn your voice into polished text.

Ultra-fast AI powered dictation that understands what you want to say and how you want to say it. Instantly turn speech into perfect emails, crisp notes, clear messages, professional communication, and more.
Features
- S1-Voice real-time shows your words as you speak in English modes
- Report an issue from the help menu or from a recording, with logs and recent dictations attached
- Pick your microphone from Sound settings, as well as the tray icon menu
- Stats display for daily, weekly, monthly and yearly and all time
Improvements
- Message mode turns spoken "new line", "period", and "quote ... end quote" into formatting, keeps dictated lists as lists, and holds your tone on long dictations
- Word replacements match inside Chinese, Japanese, and Korean, and no longer trigger in the middle of an English word
- Live text in Chinese, Japanese, and Thai no longer inserts a space between words
- Organizations can now allow specific custom-model hosts
- If your organization turns off cloud models, Superwhisper offers an offline setup when you start recording
- Long microphone names fade out before they run into the title bar buttons
- Deeplinks added for History or Check for Updates
Fixes
- Empty dictations no longer lower your words per minute or time saved
- The custom model form no longer drops what you're typing after each character
